description: Ministry of Development Stratagies & International Trade - Order made to amend the Clause No. (3) of the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1996/26 of 06.12.2016 (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to tax exemptions and regulatory provisions under the Strategic Development Projects Act. It focuses on legal/regulatory modifications to tax laws (Inland Revenue Act, Customs Ordinance) and specific regulatory frameworks for a development project, without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or detailed portfolio assignments to individuals. The content is centered on legal instruments and regulatory compliance rather than government administration or personnel matters.
